mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalogues (title, description, type, creatorId, coverImage) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{type}, #{creatorId}, #{coverImage})
mapper.select: SELECT c.catalogueId, c.title, c.description, c.type, c.creatorId, u.nickName as creatorNickName, c.coverImage FROM catalogues c JOIN users u ON c.creatorId = u.userId ORDER BY c.updateTime DESC
